newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to take steps to improve competitiveness.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to take steps to improve competitiveness.

text.p: South Korea will press ahead with sweeping financial reforms in 1997 as part of a drive to improve the country's industrial competitiveness, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
"We will accelerate measures to strengthen the economy's competitiveness," said a ministry statement which mapped out this year's economic policies.
It said South Korea wanted its financial system fully compatible with that of the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) nations.
